programme.title: Glücksbärchis - Entdecke die Magie (19)
programme.desc: Ein ganz besonderes Geschenk. Serie USA (2019). Die Glücksbärchis erfahren von Dibble, dass sie keinen Geburtstag hat. Also beschließen sie, den Tag zu feiern, an dem Dibble zu ihnen gekommen ist.

programme.title: Rubble & Crew III (22)
programme.desc: Die Baupfoten entdecken in einem Buch über Motorrad-Stunts die Großmutter von Bürgermeisterin Großherz. Oma Stunt Stella ist ein großes Vorbild für die Bürgermeisterin, die eines Tages auch den "Dreifachen Flip-o-Wow" vorführen möchte. Rubble und Crew haben die Idee, einen Motorrad-Sprung-Wettbewerb in Baubucht zu veranstalten, und dafür bauen sie Mega-Stunt-Rampen im Baseball-Stadion. Herr Schnell-Meister meldet seinen großen Bruder zum Wettbewerb an, der einen Mega-Sprung über das gesamte Baseball-Stadion machen soll. Damit Mega-Meister überhaupt eine Chance hat, den Sprung unbeschadet zu schaffen, spinnt Herr Schnell-Meister einen raffinierten Plan. Er will das Mega-Meister-Fahrzeug - von den Zuschauern unbemerkt - mit seinem Hubschrauber über das gesamte Stadion transportieren und so den Stunt vortäuschen. Aber das Mega-Meister-Mobil mit Mega-Meister und Nobbi-Nilpferd an Bord, ist zu schwer. Es stürzt zusammen mit dem Hubschrauber von Herrn Schnell-Meister in die Tiefe. Rubble und Wheeler können sie mit ihren Mega-Fahrzeugen auffangen, und alle sind gerettet. Bürgermeisterin Großherz nimmt sich ein Herz, sie wagt, mit Erpelino an ihrer Seite, den "Dreifachen Flip-o-Wow", und er gelingt. Ganz Baubucht ist begeistert, sogar Herr Schnell-Meister und Mega-Meister!

Sie verspricht, sie am Ende des Tages abzugeben. Als ihre Kräfte versagen, sind alle in Gefahr. Max hat derweil Spaß mit Jinx, was Colosso eifersüchtig macht.

programme.title: SpongeBob Schwammkopf XIV (21)
programme.desc: Sheldon Schwammkopf. Serie USA (2024). Plankton schließt sich der Schwammkopf-Familie an, in der Hoffnung, SpongeBob (und der Geheimformel) näher zu kommen.

programme.title: Submarine Jim (5)
programme.desc: Die große Schaumparty. Serie Frankreich (2024). Käpt'n Jim ist enttäuscht, als er erfährt, dass die Sardinen ohne ihn Schaum-Partys veranstalten. Unsicher, wie er als Kapitän und Freund zugleich agieren soll, gerät er in allerlei chaotische Situationen. Zwischen Glitzer, Schaum und singenden Sardinen erkennt er, dass Freundschaft über strikten Pflichten steht und er nicht alles kontrollieren muss. Schließlich wird er Teil der Party und genießt den Spaß mit Tanz, Donuts und guter Laune. Darsteller: Heiko Obermöller, Fabienne Hesse, Esther Brandt, Kirstin Hesse, Amira Leisner, David M Schulze, Julian Horeyseck, Michaela Kametz, Josef Tratnik, Martin Bross, Sarah Liu, Christiane Werk, Josef Tratnik, David M Schulze, Robert Steudtner, Michaela Kametz, Dirk Hardegen, Josef Tratnik. programme.title: Submarine Jim (6)
programme.desc: Biancas Bommel-Panik. Serie Frankreich (2024). Bianca hat andere Pläne, als Käpt'n Jim ihr die Aufgabe überträgt, auf Roy aufzupassen. Stattdessen strickt sie glitzernde Bommel, die bei den Sardinen großen Anklang finden und zu Tauschgeschäften führen. Doch das Chaos beginnt, als Roy entführt wird und Bianca 300 Bommel als Lösegeld herstellen muss. Während sie fieberhaft strickt und versucht, die Situation heimlich zu lösen, bleibt Jim ahnungslos. Darsteller: Heiko Obermöller, Fabienne Hesse, Esther Brandt, Kirstin Hesse, Amira Leisner, David M Schulze, Julian Horeyseck, Michaela Kametz, Josef Tratnik, Martin Bross, Sarah Liu, Christiane Werk, Josef Tratnik, David M Schulze, Robert Steudtner, Michaela Kametz, Dirk Hardegen, Josef Tratnik. Regie Frédéric Martin

programme.title: Bones - Die Knochenjägerin VI (10)
programme.desc: Die des mehrfachen Mordes verurteilte Totengräberin Heather Taffet hat gegen ihr Urteil Berufung eingelegt. Nun wird sie, begleitet von Sweets, zum Gericht zur Anhörung gebracht. Vor dem Gerichtsgebäude haben sich spontan Menschen versammelt, die gegen das Berufungsverfahren protestieren. Als Heather Taffet den Gefängniswagen verlässt, trifft sie eine großkalibrige Kugel in den Kopf. Sweets, der nur wenige Meter neben ihr stand, ist schwer traumatisiert. Er denkt, dass die Kugel ihm galt, da er vor dem Berufungsgericht aussagen sollte. Brennan und Booth ermitteln, dass die Kugel aus sehr weiter Entfernung abgefeuert wurde. Nur wenige Scharfschützen auf der Welt sind in der Lage, ein so kleines Ziel auf so große Entfernung zu treffen. Damit scheidet Max, Brennans Vater, als Verdächtiger aus, der schon einmal versucht hat, Heather Taffet zu töten.

programme.title: Bones - Die Knochenjägerin VI (11)
programme.desc: In einem ziemlich schicken Haus wird eine ziemlich verunstaltete Frauenleiche unter der Dusche gefunden. Zuerst vermutet man, dass es sich dabei um die Besitzerin des Hauses handelt, doch die Überreste stimmen nicht mit den Maßen der Frau überein. Bei diesen Überresten scheint es sich um eine Asiatin zu handeln. Sweets kann anhand des Facebook-Profils der Hausbesitzerin herausfinden, dass ein Mädchen namens Jenny Yang mehrfach versucht hat, eine Freundschaftsanfrage zu starten. Weitere Ermittlungen ergeben, dass das Mädchen mit dem Kauf und Verkauf von gefälschten Handtaschen in Verbindung gebracht werden kann. Clark, der zur Zeit als Praktikant im Jeffersonian tätig ist, hat sich unterdessen vorgenommen, sich seinen Kollegen etwas mehr zu öffnen, was bei den anderen aber eher Verwunderung auslöst.

programme.title: Bones - Die Knochenjägerin VI (12)
programme.desc: Zugerichtet wie eine Vogelscheuche wird mitten in einem Maisfeld eine männliche Leiche gefunden, die erschossen wurde. Allerdings lässt sich das Projektil nirgendwo finden, so dass man davon ausgehen muss, dass der Mann an einem anderen Ort erschossen wurde. Dank der Vermisstenkartei findet das FBI schnell raus, dass es sich bei dem Toten um Ed Samuels handelt. Booth und Brennan suchen die Witwe auf sowie die elf Kinder des Verstorbenen. Brennan braucht nicht lange, um herauszufinden, dass Samuels elf Nachkommen nicht von ein und derselben Frau geboren wurden. Das Familienfotoalbum gibt ihr Recht. Ed Samuels führte eine Mehrfachehe. Seine drei Ehefrauen sind allesamt Schwestern. Es liegt nahe, dass es sich bei diesem Mordmotiv um Eifersucht handelt, womit eine der drei Ehefrauen der logische Täter wäre. Doch Ed Samuels hat mit seiner Lebensweise viele Leute verärgert. Dr. Paul Lindner und Cam verabreden sich immer wieder zu einem Date, doch immer wieder muss Dr. Lindner absagen, da seine Dienste im Kreißsaal gefragt sind. Cam hat das Gefühl, Dr. Lindner sucht nur eine Ausrede, um sich nicht mit ihr treffen zu müssen und stellt ihn zur Rede.

programme.desc: Die des mehrfachen Mordes verurteilte Totengräberin Heather Taffet hat gegen ihr Urteil Berufung eingelegt. Nun wird sie, begleitet von Sweets, zum Gericht zur Anhörung gebracht. programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S03E20 PROKRASTINÁTOŘI: Gumball s Darwinem mají za úkol vynést odpadky do pěti hodin a hledají všechny myslitelné způsoby prokrastinace. SKOŘÁPKA: Gumball nechtěně rozbije Pennyinu skořápku a spatří její skutečné já. Zbývá přesvědčit Penny že její pravé já je úžasné.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S03E21 Gumball obdrží děsivý e-mail od strašlivého ducha a rozhodne se ho ignorovat navzdory Darwinově radě. Odmítá to přiznat, ale prokletí se stane skutečností a celou rodinu to vtáhne do jiné dimenze. Gumball a Darwin s pomocí Carrie ale rodinu zachrání./Ředitel Brown dá Gumballovi a Darwinovi starého školního křečka Chrise Morrise, aby se o něj přes víkend postarali. Oni ho však omylem nechají ve škole a místo něj si domů odnesou příčesek ředitele Browna. Překvapivě jim připadá jako nejlepší mazlíček. Když si uvědomí, že skutečného Chrise Morrise nechali ve škole, musí si pospíšit, aby vše napravili, než se na jejich omyl přijde.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E25 "Anais má novou kamarádku, ale Gumball s Darwinem pochybují, že jde o vztah rovnocenný. Při čtení Anaisina deníčku zjistí, že její vztah s novou kamarádkou se zdá poněkud jednostranný. Jodie snědla Anaisin oběd, shrábla zásluhy za její práci a přinutila ji nést jí batoh. Gumball si o ní myslí, že je parazit, a chce dokázat, že vymyla Anais mozek. Ale když obě dívky splynou do jednoho organismu, není snadné poznat, kdo že je parazit a kdo hostitel…"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E26 "Obyvatelé města Elmore pátrají po smyslu lásky. Když Bobert zjistí, že ho napadl virus s názvem miluji_tě.exe, požádá Gumballa s Darwinem, aby mu vysvětlili význam slova "láska". Ti se mu ho pokusí vysvětlit pomocí písně, ale tím mu pochopení vůbec neusnadní. A tak poprosí ostatní obyvatele města Elmore, aby se podělili o vlastní pohled na to, co pro ně znamená láska."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E39 "Gumball, Darwin a Carrie se spřáhnou a přesvědčí své spolužáky, že ve škole straší. Během halloweenské prezentace děti Gumballově historce o Gargarothovi Požírači zprvu nevěří; pak ale Carrie nafinguje, že ve třídě příšerně straší. Trojice školu přesvědčí, aby si je najala na vyhánění duchů, a nechávají si zaplatit halloweenskými sladkostmi. Jenže když se ukáže, že Gargaroth skutečně existuje, všichni předpokládají, že Gumball město zachrání."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E27 "Gumball jde stejným směrem jako Hotdog a s každým dalším krokem je jim to čím dál tím trapnější. Gumball je tak zabraný do zpívání o kečupu, že vrazí do Hotdoga. Tuhle trapnou chvilku se jim sice povede překonat, ale vzápětí zjistí, že se ubírají stejným směrem. Jejich společná cesta je čím dál tím trapnější, až se je nakonec pokusí zatknout popletený hlídač obchodu a konečně jim umožní, aby se rozešli každý za svým…"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E28 "Obyvatelé města Elmore se záhadně ztrácejí a příčina těchto zmizení by se Gumballa s Darwinem mohla týkat víc, než si myslí. Z mimořádného zpravodajství se Wattersonovi dozvědí, že jejich soused se stal obětí jednoho ze záhadných zmizení, k nimž došlo napříč městem. Pátrání po stopách je dovede až k podivnému vejci, které, jak se brzy ukáže, patří jejich vlastní Zlé želvě. Wattersonovi si uvědomí, že nesou zodpovědnost za to, aby svého mazlíčka vystopovali, než se svými mláďaty napáchá ve městě další škody."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E29 "Gumball a Darwin slíbí dělat za Tobiase všechny domácí práce výměnou za ""body k dobru"". Gumball s Darwinem zjistili, že si Tobias v online hře Galaktrek vede mnohem lépe než oni. Tobias přiznal, že si plněním domácích prací pro rodiče vydělává body, které pak vyměňuje za peníze, aby si mohl koupit super vybavení pro Galaktrek. Pokud Gumball s Darwinem splní jeho povinnosti místo něj, dovolí jim získat body a použít je na Galaktrek. Gumballovi s Darwinem se zdá, že udělali terno. Ale tyhle body možná nebudou tak skvělé, jak Tobias tvrdí…"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E30 "Školní autobus je unesen, ale sami únosci byli zřejmě uneseni. Když Rocky naznačí, že děti z Elmorské osmiletky chodí za školu, autobus obsadí zločinci, kteří jim chtějí ukázat, jak je školní docházka důležitá. Maskovaní bandité jsou očividně rodiče dětí, kteří předstírají přepadení, aby jim uštědřili lekci, ale když se do toho vloží policie, je jasné, že celou situaci má pod kontrolou někdo jiný než rodiče."

programme.desc: S02E23 Wattersonovi jsou normální rodinka. Táta je růžový králík a stará se o děti, zatímco máma pracuje v továrně na duhu. Nejstarší z dětí je Gumball, modrý kocour, pak je tu geniální čtyřletá králičí holčička Anais a nakonec Darwin, zlatá rybka, které narostly nohy. Hlavním hrdinou příběhů je Gumball, který se potýká se stejnými problémy a výzvami jako ostatní dvanáctiletí kluci - třeba když musí prchat před útočícím Tyrannosaurem Rexem nebo spát pod mostem, protože mu robot ukradne totožnost, nebo se má převléknout za roztleskávačku a dělat roznožky, aby udělal dojem na dívku svých snů. Vítejte v Gumballově úžasném světě, ve kterém je všechno normální tak trochu divné.

programme.desc: S06E23 "Gumball a Darwin se ocitnou v potížích, když souhlasí se vším, co řekne nový kluk ve škole. Pravda je o to složitější, že mu nerozumí ani slovo. Peter Pepperoni se až doteď vzdělával doma a vytvořil si tak zvláštní způsob mluvy. Kvůli sérii nedorozumění se Darwin a Gumball ocitnou na útěku před zákonem."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S06E24 "Wattersonovi si potřebují přivydělat, a tak pronajmou svůj dům. Jenomže nemají kam jít, a tak se rozhodnou v domě i nadále tajně bydlet. Když své hosty, jimiž je párek postarších koz, náhle v domě překvapí, hosté omdlí a Wattersonovi, kteří se obávají nejhoršího, musí tuhle nehodu nějak zamaskovat."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S06E28 "Richard neotevře dostatečně rychle dveře a poslíček, který se mu za to chce pomstít, mu proto nepředá jeho zásilku. Richard má na vybranou: buď si zásilku vyzvedne v depu, nebo si ji nechá znovu doručit. Jenomže Richard nechce ani jedno, a tak se rozpoutá souboj vůlí, který může skončit pouze zkázou jednoho z nich."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S06E29 "Všichni předpokládají, že je vztah Darwina a Carrie odsouzený k záhubě, protože jsou každý tak jiný. Tedy všichni až na Darwina a Carrie. Když se pak na scéně objeví senzační bývalý přítel Carrie, donutí Gumball Darwina, aby oba konfrontoval a zjistil, co se to vlastně děje."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S06E30 "Anais a školní magor Jamie jsou obvinění ze stejného zločinu. Proto musí spojit síly a najít pravého pachatele a dokázat svou nevinu. Po vyřešení případu jim dojde, že mají víc společného, než si myslely."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S06E32 "Táta se rozhodne vyřešit spory všech Wattersonových pomocí mečů, magie a své oblíbené deskové hry na hrdiny. A tak se rodina vydává na dobrodružnou výpravu, bojovat s mýtickými tvory. Dokáží spojit síly a překonat své rozpory?"

programme.desc: S03E27 Na hodině biologie Gumball s Darwinem čekají na to, až se z kukly vyklube krásný motýl. Slečna Šimpánová je varuje před motýlím efektem. Podle něj může zatřepotání hmyzích křídel uvést do chodu sérii událostí, které na opačném konci světa způsobí tornádo. Gumball na to nedbá a vypustí čerstvě vylíhnutého motýla do přírody, načež se nad Elmorem rozpoutá peklo.../Poté, co se Gumball s Darwinem přejí sladkých cereálií, začnou dumat nad tajemstvím vesmíru. Potřebují porozumět smyslu života a žádají o radu celý Elmore. Ptají se lidí, zvířat a dokonce i planet. Ale odpovědi jim přinese až nečekaný zdroj...

programme.title: Mladí Titáni do toho!
programme.desc: S02E40 Rose Wilsonová uteče z vězení a poráží Titány chytrými urážkami. Jen Raven je proti nim imunní. Nakonec se spřátelí a podnikají spolu spoustu věcí. Kyborg, Starfire a Beast Boy se cítí uboze, tak jdou do školy pro frajery.

programme.title: Mladí Titáni do toho!

programme.title: Mladí Titáni do toho!
programme.desc: S07E51 Titáni mají problém vyrovnat se se svými emocemi, když zlý skladatel změní hudbu v jejich pořadu.

programme.title: Mladí Titáni do toho!
programme.desc: S07E48 Pohoršeni vysokou cenou, kterou platí za vodu, plyn a elektřinu se Titáni snaží být soběstační.

programme.title: Looney Tunes: Animáky
programme.desc: S05E02 Looney Tunes slaví Halloween. Daffy a Porky doprovází drahého přítele na místo posledního odpočinku. Čarodějnice Hazel pronásleduje přísadu pro svůj lektvar. Sylvester najde podezřelý motel a Bugs se setká s mumií.

programme.title: Looney Tunes: Animáky
programme.desc: S01E03 Sylvester si myslí, že ho straší duch Tweetyho. / Elmer chytá Bugse, ale ten skočí do své nory. Když se pokusí Bugse z nory dostat, něco se stane. / Daffy z chodníku sebere kus žvýkačky, která mu připraví lepivou nepříjemnost.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E07 "Gumball se dozví, že Wattersonovi už celé roky kradou wi-fi pana Robinsona. Když jednou wi-fi přestane fungovat, pokusí se žít bez ní. Ale život bez internetu se ukáže jako příliš těžký. Gumball s Darwinem se proto rozhodnou, že se prohackují kyberprostorem a zjistí Robinsonovo heslo."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E08 "Gumballa naštve, když mu v internetovém testu opakovaně vyjde, že je typ postavy zvaný ""Trapák"". Je přesvědčený, že se téhle nálepky zbaví jedině tak, že bude dělat přesný opak všeho, co dělá normálně. Jenže když Gumball potlačí svoje přirozené pudy, zanechá po sobě vakuum - díru ve tvaru Gumballa, kterou někdo musí zaplnit. A ten někdo je Tobias, který seriál začne proměňovat v otřepaný sitcom."

programme.title: Totální Dramarama
programme.desc: S03E10 Coudy hrozně křičí ze spaní a ostatní nemohou odpočívat. Gwen a Duncan se vydají na strastiplnou cestu do jeho podvědomí.

programme.title: Totální Dramarama
programme.desc: S03E11 Courtney se snaží dosáhnout svého tím, že pořídí mozkový ovladač. Všechno se zvrtne, když padne ovladač do špatných rukou.

programme.title: Totální Dramarama
programme.desc: S03E12 Šéf se těší na prodloužený víkend. Plány mu zhatí jeho vlastní zapomnětlivost.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E09 "Náhodné setkání se ženou jeho snů přiměje Rockyho, aby přestal žít na internetu a začal hledat lásku pomocí nejnovější seznamovací aplikace. Gumball s Darwinem se Rockymu snaží pomoct proklestit si cestu ošidným světem vztahů přes internet. Při honbě za Rockyho vysněnou dívkou navíc zjistí, že když lidem řeknete, že jednáte ve jménu lásky, odpustí vám téměř cokoli."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E10 "Gumball s Darwinem dají Bobertovi vlastní pokyny, protože chtějí zajistit, aby se choval bezpečně a zodpovědně. Když Bobert začne na jejich pravidla aplikovat svoji robotickou logiku, rychle jim dojde, že se budou muset vyjadřovat mnohem jasněji. Jinak je nakonec všechny zničí…"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E11 "Nicole se marně snaží skrýt zklamání, když Richard s dětmi zapomenou na její významný den. Richard musí přijít na to, na jaký významný den zapomněl, a dnešek učinit nezapomenutelným dnem, jinak bude zle!"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E40 "Elmorské zprávy na Kanálu 6 vysílají ty nejžhavější místní příběhy od policejní honičky až po exkluzivní zprávu o Oslici Daisy. Zkušený hlasatel Kip Schlezinger je právě tím, kdo přináší nejnovější zprávy, také ze sportu a o počasí, i když není vůbec o čem referovat…"

programme.title: Gumballův báječně potrhlý svět
programme.desc: S01E05 Vítejte zpět v Elmóru! Čekají vás překvapivé zvraty, bizarní humor, neobyčejný rodinný život. To je teď nový Gumballův báječně potrhlý svět!

programme.title: Gumballův báječně potrhlý svět
programme.desc: S01E04 Wattersonovi jsou normální rodinka. Táta je růžový králík a stará se o děti, zatímco máma pracuje v továrně na duhu. Nejstarší z dětí je Gumball, modrý kocour, pak je tu geniální čtyřletá králičí holčička Anais a nakonec Darwin, zlatá rybka, které narostly nohy. Hlavním hrdinou příběhů je Gumball, který se potýká se stejnými problémy a výzvami jako ostatní dvanáctiletí kluci - třeba když musí prchat před útočícím Tyrannosaurem Rexem nebo spát pod mostem, protože mu robot ukradne totožnost, nebo se má převléknout za roztleskávačku a dělat roznožky, aby udělal dojem na dívku svých snů. Vítejte v Gumballově úžasném světě, ve kterém je všechno normální tak trochu divné…

Když Frankie pak dorazí k nim, rozhodnou se udělat mu pohodlí tak, že mu zajistí nepohodlí a promění svůj dům ve věznici."

Zjistí, že jejich rodina vydělává na tom, že kopíruje rodinu Wattersonových! Poté, co se je marně snaží navést k tomu, aby si našli vlastní identity, Wattersonovým dojde, že musejí pro daný problém najít trvalejší řešení."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E20 "Když Gumball s Darwinem zjistí, že děda Louie nemá žádné přátele na Elmore Plus, z lítosti mu vytvoří Muriel. Jenže když se babička Jojo dozví, že Louie tráví čas na internetu s jinou "ženou", neexistence Muriel jí nezabrání v tom, aby ji zničila."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S03E27 Na hodině biologie Gumball s Darwinem čekají na to, až se z kukly vyklube krásný motýl. Slečna Šimpánová je varuje před motýlím efektem. Podle něj může zatřepotání hmyzích křídel uvést do chodu sérii událostí, které na opačném konci světa způsobí tornádo. Gumball na to nedbá a vypustí čerstvě vylíhnutého motýla do přírody, načež se nad Elmorem rozpoutá peklo.../Poté, co se Gumball s Darwinem přejí sladkých cereálií, začnou dumat nad tajemstvím vesmíru. Potřebují porozumět smyslu života a žádají o radu celý Elmore. Ptají se lidí, zvířat a dokonce i planet. Ale odpovědi jim přinese až nečekaný zdroj...

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S03E31 """Gumball, Darwin a Anais odhalí, že máma Banána Joea maluje obrázky, které předpovídají budoucnost. Když objeví jeden, na kterém Gumball pobíhá nahý po obchodním domě, Gumball nehodlá něco takového dopustit. Všechno se proti němu spikne a Gumball se tak naučí, že občas se s osudem bojovat nedá. / Když pan Small pustí ve třídě video ohledně zdraví a předcházení úrazům, Darwin začne být posedlý myšlenkou, že musí Wattersonovým zajistit bezpečí. Snaží se je chránit před okolním světem a brzy se Darwinova přehnaná ochrana rozšíří do všech koutů Elmoru. Wattersonovi nemají na vybranou. Musí svrhnout jeho despotický režim."""

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E31 "Zajímá vás, o čem sní občané Elmoru? Když slunce nad Elmorem zapadne, měsíc nás vezme na výlet do rozmanitých snů a nočních můr podřimujících obyvatel města. Dozvíme se, po čem jednotlivé postavy v hloubi duše touží, z čeho mají největší strach i to, jak jsou ujeté."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E32 "Gumball se má sejít s Penny v nákupním centru, ale jde pozdě a cestou se ještě víc zdrží kvůli celé řadě nedorozumění. Gumball v tom má zmatek - myslí si, že měl vzít Penny na rande na večeři, ale měli zajít na oběd do podniku s názvem "Večeře". Utíká do nákupáku, ale každý, koho cestou potká, ho špatně pochopí."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E33 "Wattersonovi se snaží Darwinovi připomenout jeho rybí kořeny. Když máma vidí, jak Darwin dlouze hledí do akvária, napadne ji, že životní styl savců jejího adoptivního syna nenaplňuje a v hloubi duše touží po návratu ke svým rybím kořenům. A tak se rodina pokusí obnovit jeho spojení s životem ve vodě. Zkusí rybí krmivo, rybí řeč a dokonce i rybí oblečení. Když nic z toho nezabere, uvědomí si, že ho možná budou muset nechat jít."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E34 "Sdružení rodičů a učitelů z Elmorské osmiletky zakáže videohry, a tak se děti snaží dokázat, že na ně videohry nemají špatný vliv. Gumball zasvětí Billyho do světa videoher, ale ten z čiré radosti omdlí. Jeho matka Felicity svolá sdružení a vyhrožuje, že zakáže videohry v celém Elmoru. Gumball s Darwinem dostanou tři příležitosti prokázat, že videohry mohou být užitečné, ale když neuspějí, rozhodnou se dokázat, že knihy mohou mít stejně zhoubný vliv."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E35 "Gumball se urazí, když ho Tobias nepoplácá po zadku jako všechny ostatní. Tobias ke každému plácnutí rukou přidá plácnutí přes zadek, takže když Gumballa vynechá, ten se cítí dotčen. Celý den se snaží, aby ho Tobias plácnul po zadku, ale když to nevyjde, usoudí, že aby se dočkal, musejí spolu strávit nějaký čas o samotě a vybudovat si dostatečně důvěrný vztah."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E36 "Anais ve svém pokojíku najde nepořádek jako po vloupání a zjistí, že její plyšák Daisy zmizel. Dojde jí, že hlavními podezřelými jsou Gumball s Darwinem. Jediná možnost, jak odhalit, co se stalo s Daisy, je zahájit důkladně vyšetřování. Postupně přichází záhadě na kloub a zdá se, že pachatelé kápnou božskou."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E37 "Nicole navštíví záhadná postava z její minulosti a vyzve ji na souboj, ale ona k údivu svých dětí odmítne. Očekávají, že když ona neznámá urazí jejich mámu, budou svědky velkolepého souboje, ale máma se kupodivu rozhodne pro mírové řešení. Vysvětlí jim, že Yuki, matka Masami, je kamarádka ze školních let, která se ji opakovaně a marně snaží vyprovokovat k souboji. Ovšem když Yuki začne mámě vyhrožovat vyhazovem z práce, nemá na výběr a musí přistoupit na odvetný souboj v karate, který jí od dětství dluží."

programme.desc: S02E34 Wattersonovi jsou normální rodinka. Táta je růžový králík a stará se o děti, zatímco máma pracuje v továrně na duhu. Nejstarší z dětí je Gumball, modrý kocour, pak je tu geniální čtyřletá králičí holčička Anais a nakonec Darwin, zlatá rybka, které narostly nohy. Hlavním hrdinou příběhů je Gumball, který se potýká se stejnými problémy a výzvami jako ostatní dvanáctiletí kluci - třeba když musí prchat před útočícím Tyrannosaurem Rexem nebo spát pod mostem, protože mu robot ukradne totožnost, nebo se má převléknout za roztleskávačku a dělat roznožky, aby udělal dojem na dívku svých snů. Vítejte v Gumballově úžasném světě, ve kterém je všechno normální tak trochu divne.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Motherlode
programme.desc: Augur is caught and placed in a special prison where he is placed in a sensory deprivation chamber. An amoralist gets him out and wants Augur to help him steal the gold Zo'or has on the mothership. When Liam learns of what happened he tries to find Augur.

programme.desc: The Taelons decide to leave Earth when it appears that the Jiridians are invading. Meanwhile, a group of Resistance prisoners saved from the mother ship include several disguised Jiridians who are causing trouble for Liam and Renee.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Essence
programme.desc: Renee's brother has PTSD. In a desperate effort to help him, she agrees to let him undergo special treatment. The treatment removes his emotion. The project is overseen by Sandoval and the emotion they take is given to Da'an.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Phantom Companion
programme.desc: While on board the mothership, Renee sustains an injury and while being treated, she gets pulled into the walls and disappears.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Dream Stalker
programme.desc: Street asks Liam to help a friend who's arrested for the murder of a man he hated. Liam talks to him and he claims that he dreamed of killing him.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Lost Generation
programme.desc: A CVI malfunctions and kills a soon-to-be father. The investigation leads Liam and Renee to a fertility clinic. Renee finds out she is infertile and suspects that Taelon technology is affecting worldwide fertility.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: The Summit
programme.desc: Da'an leaves and doesn't being Liam along. Zo'or is frantic as to why Da'an left. Liam wants to help but Zo'or doesn't trust him because he doesn't have a CVI, so Liam agrees to be implanted.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Dark Matter
programme.desc: When the mother ship hits dark matter, the ship dos not begin to heal itself. Zo'or is left in an unconscious state and Sandoval takes control. He decides it is time to liberate the Earth from the Taelons.

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Trapped by Time

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Atonement

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Hearts and Minds

programme.title: Earth: Final Conflict: Epiphany
programme.desc: The Taelons announce that they will all go into death stasis and wait on the mother ship for humans to discover how to create core energy and revive them. Zo'or and Da'an don't trust each other to be the last to submit to stasis.

programme.title: Adventures of a Taxi Driver
programme.desc: Joe likes the ladies and gets to meet a variety of them in his job as a taxi driver. From dizzy young women to frustrated housewives, Joe fancies them all, and they take a fancy to Joe. If only things were smoother at home for the put-upon cabbie. With his nagging mother, thieving teenage brother, and the attentions of an overbearing girlfriend with ideas of marriage, Joe leaves the homestead and rents the spare room at his best mate's flat. Meanwhile, he continues to find himself in an assortment of humorous sexual escapades until he accidentally becomes embroiled in a jewel heist that doesn't quite go to plan.

programme.title: It Follows
programme.desc: For 19-year-old Jay (Maika Monroe), the fall should be about school, boys and weekends out at the lake. But after a seemingly innocent sexual encounter, she finds herself plagued by strange visions and the inescapable sense that someone, or something, is following her. Faced with this burden, Jay and her teenage friends must find a way to escape the horrors that seem to be only a few steps behind.

programme.title: The Butterfly Effect
programme.desc: In The Butterfly Effect Evan Treborn (Ashton Kutcher) has lost crucial moments of his life, his childhood scarred by a series of terrifying events he can't remember. When Evan realises that by reading his diaries he can unlock the past and go back in time, he tries to reclaim the missing memories by tampering with the past... with unexpected and disastrous results! The more Evan tampers with time, the more his life - and that of his friend Kayleigh (Amy Smart) - begin to unravel, and he discovers there is no such thing as a happy ending!

programme.title: G-Loc
programme.desc: In a world on the brink of environmental collapse, mass migration to neighbouring planet, Rhea, is humanity's final hope for survival. The only problem is, in the sixteen Earth years since the first humans landed on Rhea, two hundred and eighty-eight years have passed on the new planet and the existing population are no longer welcoming new arrivals, with the Rheans having set up a space blockade to shot down any ship that tries to cross into their territory. 'Earther', Bran, has big dreams of a better life in this new world, but the odds are stacked against him. Finding himself the lone survivor of a failed emigration attempt, his escape pod floats mindlessly in space and his oxygen is running low. His only chance of survival is to hook up to a rogue Rhean supply ship called The Nysa running on auxiliary power. But after finding the crew on board The Nysa dead, it seems Bran may have more than just a hostile planet to worry about. An intense interstellar thriller with an impressive cast, including Stephen Moyer (True Blood), Casper Van Dien (Starship Troopers) and John Rhys-Davies (the Indiana Jones and Lord of the Rings franchises).

programme.title: 12 in a Box
programme.desc: 12 IN A BOX is the laugh-out-loud story of 12 former school friends who get together for a reunion they will never forget, where they are given the chance to win a life-changing 1million each. The only catch is, they cannot leave the estate for 96 hours, and anyone who enters the grounds must also stay for the duration! With time ticking away, the mismatched dozen are forced to work together to keep the peace and work toward their payday. But, when they have to deal with an untimely death, a kidnapping plot, another corpse, burglars, and then even a visit from the boys in blue, will this hapless clan be able to hold it together or will their dreams of riches be buried with the bodies? Staring Miranda Hart (Miranda, Call the Midwife) and Katy Wix (Not Going Out), this is classic British farce at its best.

programme.title: The Way
programme.desc: Martin Sheen plays Tom, an American doctor who comes to France to collect the remains of his adult son who was killed in the Pyrenees in a storm while walking The Camino de Santiago - also known as 'The Way of Saint James'. Driven by his desire to understand his lost son, Tom decides to embark on the historical pilgrimage, leaving his California life behind. Armed only with his son's backpack and guidebook, he begins the 800km historical pilgrimage but soon discovers that he won't be alone on this journey - he meets other pilgrims from around the world, all broken and looking for greater meaning in their lives. From the hardship experienced along "The Way" an unlikely group of misfits are bonded and Tom begins to learn the difference between 'The life we live and the life we choose.'

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Riveting Sci-Fi action-thriller Push is set in a deadly world of psychic espionage where the ability to move objects using only the mind, see the future, create new realities and kill without ever touching the victim can turn a person into a lethal weapon - or a target. A young man (Chris Evans - Sunshine, Fantastic Four ) and a teenage girl with extraordinary gifts (Dakota Fanning - War of the Worlds) take on a clandestine agency in a battle they can win only if they change the future.

programme.title: Me, Myself and Di
programme.desc: After winning the 'trip of a lifetime' to a caravan park in Rhyl, North Wales, unlucky in love Northerner, Janet Brown, is ready for a holiday romance. Unfortunately, following the advice of best friend Diana (Lucy Pinder) - that Janet should pretend to be the opposite of who she actually is in order to find love - doesn't quite lead to the happily ever after she was hoping for. A laugh-out-loud gritty rom-com with a huge ensemble cast including James Lance (Northern Soul, Bronson, Marie Antoinette, Bel Ami), Will Mellor (Two Pints of Lager and a Packet of Crisps, Line of Duty), Larry Lamb (EastEnders, The Hatton Garden Job), Marek Oravec (Captain America: The First Avenger), Wim Snape (The Full Monty, Coronation Street), and Katy Clayton (Casualty, Shameless).

programme.title: Call of The Wild
programme.desc: Call of The Wild is a modern-day story incorporating elements of Jack London's classic short novel. Whilst Ryann (Ariel Gade) is staying with her Grandpa Bill (Christopher Lloyd) a wild hybrid wolf/dog shows up injured on the back porch one night. Ryann and a local friend believe they can train the magnificent animal to become a sled dog leader but first they must try and persuade Grandpa, who knows the animal will eventually have to return to the wild. Then they must stand up to the local bully who wants to claim the dog as his own.

programme.title: The Butterfly Effect
programme.desc: In The Butterfly Effect Evan Treborn (Ashton Kutcher) has lost crucial moments of his life, his childhood scarred by a series of terrifying events he can't remember. When Evan realises that by reading his diaries he can unlock the past and go back in time, he tries to reclaim the missing memories by tampering with the past... with unexpected and disastrous results! The more Evan tampers with time, the more his life - and that of his friend Kayleigh (Amy Smart) - begin to unravel, and he discovers there is no such thing as a happy ending!

programme.title: I Spit On Your Grave
programme.desc: In 1978, one film changed the face of cinema forever. Long established as one of the most debated and divisive movies of all time, I Spit On Your Grave has been condemned by some as 'vile and depraved', whilst others hail it as a 'misunderstood masterpiece of cinema', 'the ultimate feminist movie'. Re-experience the phenomenon that shocked and divided the world, and influenced an entire genre and generation of film-makers, with Camille Keaton's portrayal of young writer Jennifer Hills, her horrific plans for revenge, and some of the most gruesomely, unforgettable scenes ever captured to film.

programme.title: I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu
programme.desc: Finally, after 1978's I Spit On Your Grave shocked the world with its story of a beautiful career woman assaulted and left for dead, and her notorious revenge on those responsible, cinema's most lethal Lady Vengeance returns in the most anticipated sequel of all time. Reuniting star Camille Keaton and original director Meir Zarchi, I Spit On Your Grave: Deja Vu sends now successful writer Jennifer Hills hurtling back to where it all began - to face the wrath of the families of those she murdered. Kidnapped along with her daughter Christy, it's a tense game of hunt - or be hunted - against a ruthless gang of degenerates and their violently unhinged matriarch, Becky. Hailed as a feminist revenge masterpiece by some, and misunderstood as crude exploitation by others, revenge is about to come full circle in Deja Vu, the final chapter in cinema's most shocking cult franchise.

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: A chronicle of Gertrude Bell's life, a traveler, writer, archaeologist, explorer, cartographer, and political attach for the British Empire at the dawn of the twentieth century.

programme.title: The Monster
programme.desc: A mother and daughter must confront a terrifying monster when they break down on a deserted road.

programme.title: The Hitman's Apprentice
programme.desc: When 19-year-old Adam agrees to do a day's driving for his mum's gangster boyfriend Peter, it takes him on a 24-hour journey into a nightmarish world of murder, sex trafficking and revenge, in the company of aging hit man Roy.

programme.title: Love N' Dancing
programme.desc: Jessica (Amy Smart) had given up on her dream of a life of the stage, until she meets ex-dance champion Jake (Tom Malloy), who becomes her teacher when the couple make an instant connection. Together, they decide to risk it all when they enter the World Swing Championship to reclaim Jake's former title.

programme.title: Adventures of a Plumber's Mate
programme.desc: Times are hard for plumber Sid South. Up to his neck in bills, facing eviction from his home and in debt to a violent bookie, he desperately needs to raise some funds or else Sid will be a broken man - literally, as there are two thugs ready to break every bone in his body unless he hands over the cash he owes their boss. It doesn't help that Sid never seems to get paid for any of the work he does, as his occupation lands him in a variety of risqu situations which always end in disaster. Drastic times call for drastic measures, and the browbeaten plumber seeks employment from Dodger, a shady wheeler-dealer who can put some dubious work Sid's way. But, as always, things never seem to go exactly to plan and the beguiled plumber finds himself in further strife.

programme.title: Me, Myself and Di
programme.desc: After winning the 'trip of a lifetime' to a caravan park in Rhyl, North Wales, unlucky in love Northerner, Janet Brown, is ready for a holiday romance. programme.title: Gladiatress
programme.desc: 55BC Somewhere In Britain: The Princesses of the Dubonni tribe are three unlikely sisters: Smirgut The Fierce (Fiona Allen), ferocious warrior and full-time mum, Dwyfuc (Doon Mackichan), desperate spinster in search of a hairy husband and Worthaboutapig (Sally Phillips), clumsy village bee-herder. Roman soldiers kidnap Dwyfuc, detaining her in Boulogne. Seduced by Roman society, she reveals locations of British ports crucial to the Romanss invasion strategy. Smirgut and Worthaboutapig set out on a perilous rescue mission together they must prevent the downfall of Celtic Britain, encountering gods, lawyers, soothsayers, barbarians and the Otherworld. Girl power is alive and kicking and ready to take on the Romans

programme.title: Pandorum
programme.desc: Two astronauts (Dennis Quaid, Vantage Point and Ben Foster, 30 Days of Night) awaken in a hyper-sleep chamber aboard a seemingly abandoned spacecraft. It's pitch black, they are disoriented, and the only sound is a low rumble and creak from the belly of the ship. They can't remember anything like who they are and what their mission is, but one thing they do realise very quickly is that they are not alone. Slowly the spacecraft's shocking, deadly secrets are revealed and the astronauts find that they must fight to stay alive and that their survival is more important than they could ever have imagined. Directed by Christian Alvart and also starring Cam Gigandet (Twilight), Cung Le (Tekken) and newcomer Antje Traue.

programme.title: Lady Bloodfight
programme.desc: Jane is a beautiful but troubled American girl backpacking her way through Hong Kong. When she successfully fends off three thugs trying to rob her, it draws the attention of Shu, a Wudang champion, who is impressed by her raw street fighting abilities. Shu recruits Jane and trains her to fight in the vicious, all-female, underground martial arts tournament known as The Kumite.

programme.title: It's a Boy Girl Thing
programme.desc: It's A Boy Girl Thing is a brilliantly funny romantic comedy about next-door neighbours who live worlds apart. Woody Deane (Zegers) and Nell Bedworth (Armstrong) are life long sworn enemies who wake up one day to find themselves in a very strange place: each others bodies. In their switched identities, each sets out to destroy the other's high school reputation. When they start to succeed they get more than they bargained for. Sometimes falling in love can be an out of body experience.

From the hardship experienced along "The Way" an unlikely group of misfits are bonded and Tom begins to learn the difference between 'The life we live and the life we choose.'

programme.title: Call of The Wild
programme.desc: Call of The Wild is a modern-day story incorporating elements of Jack London's classic short novel. Whilst Ryann (Ariel Gade) is staying with her Grandpa Bill (Christopher Lloyd) a wild hybrid wolf/dog shows up injured on the back porch one night. Ryann and a local friend believe they can train the magnificent animal to become a sled dog leader but first they must try and persuade Grandpa, who knows the animal will eventually have to return to the wild. Then they must stand up to the local bully who wants to claim the dog as his own.

programme.title: Shop on TV
programme.desc: Teleshopping.

programme.title: Dermot's Taste of Ireland
programme.desc: Dermot O'Leary arrives in Sligo, Yeats country, where the mountains, sea and sky feel like they've barely changed since the poet put them into verse. Local guide Tracey brings that world to life, tracing Yeats' Irish-English existence and the places that shaped him. From there, Dermot heads out onto the bay with Glen and Aisling of Sligo Oysters, getting his hands dirty on a working oyster farm before cooking the catch over an open flame on the shore. In Sligo town, he meets man-of-the-town chef Anthony Gray, who leads him through two of its most treasured food institutions: Clarke's, a family butcher of long standing, and Cosgrove & Sons, a provisions store that looks and feels like it hasn't changed in a century. With their haul gathered, Anthony and Dermot head to his flagship restaurant Eala Bán, where they cook up a proudly Irish Surf 'N' Turf.

programme.title: Clodagh: Cooking at Home
programme.desc: Clodagh's sharing her strategy for throwing a perfect fuss-free dinner party. There's an effortless and easy menu with shortcut cacio e pepe cheese straws to welcome the guests, a quick and impressive French classic chicken fricassée for a fabulous main course, a stunning make-ahead pistachio tiramisu for dessert and fresh mint tea to end the evening. Her blueprint includes a stunning table setting where the trick is keeping things simple. This is all about hosting a fun and fuss-free dinner party Clodagh-style.

programme.title: Unwind with ITV
programme.desc: Your daily escape designed to calm the mind and encourage relaxation and reflection. [S]

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: This week Liz and Kelvin get quizzed on artificial insemination by Milo, and Marnie beings halter training Hope ahead of the Royal Cheshire Country Show. [SL,S,AD]

programme.title: James Martin's Islands to Highlands
programme.desc: Northern Ireland - Part Two: James returns to Northern Ireland with Paul Rankin to explore around Lough Neagh, the biggest freshwater lake in the British Isles. [S,AD] S1 Ep8

programme.title: James Martin's Saturday Morning
programme.desc: James cooks lamb and turbot for the brilliant actor Richard Armitage, currently starring in ITV1's crime series Winter. Plus, chefs Atul Kochhar, John Hooker and three-Michelin starred Mark Birchall join James in the kitchen.

programme.title: Cooking With the Stars
programme.desc: Emma Willis and Tom Allen host as three new contestants - reality star Joey Essex, popstar and presenter JB Gill and actor Lesley Joseph - go head-to-head in a three-way cooking battle. They'll have to produce delicious BBQ dishes using indoor grills. The star with the best dish goes straight through to the next round, while the other two will have to face the cook-off - where one star will leave the competition.

programme.title: ITV News
programme.desc: National and international news with reports and analysis from ITV's Correspondents in the UK and around the world. [S]

programme.title: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
programme.desc: Samuel West, Rishi Nair and Clarkson's Farm's Harriet Cowan join Alan. Elsewhere, there's the launch of a brand-new wildlife garden project, and Instagram and farming sensation Karl Franklin shows off his sheep herding skills. Plus, a catch-up with the East Sussex Wildlife Rescue Ambulance Service as they prepare to release some herring gulls back into the wild. Lager is the order of the day in today's Best of British.

programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm
programme.desc: It's a busy time on the farm as the family prepares pigs for the butcher, ready to become sausages for their stall at the Royal Cheshire Show. But Liz's plans are interrupted when she discovers an injured hen that has been badly pecked by the cockerel. She takes the bird to her friend Debbie, a chicken expert, who gives it some much-needed care before it returns to the farm sporting a rather stylish accessory. With Liz away, Kelvin enjoys a day with the boys, who get stuck into farm life as they help feed the pigs and build a new chicken coop. Liz also finds time for a quieter job, creating seasonal hanging baskets to brighten up the holiday cottage. But there's a bigger problem in the front field, where flooding has put planting on hold. Liz and Kelvin bring out the digger to find a blocked drain and get the water flowing again, with crops waiting to go into the ground.

programme.desc: A round-up of royal news with expert analysis from ITV News Royal Editor Chris Ship, ITV News royal expert Lizzie Robinson and a host of guests.

programme.title: The Essex Millionaire Murders
programme.desc: The first part of a two-part documentary series. Easter Sunday, 2023 - a wealthy couple in their 60s are found dead by their daughter on Mersea Island in Essex. Carol and Stephen Baxter are in their armchairs with no sign of a struggle as police rule out carbon monoxide poisoning - when Senior Investigating Officer Lydia George and her team discover a mysterious will that leaves everything to the Baxters' daughter Ellena and their family friend Luke D'Wit, the detectives find out that D'Wit was helping Carol as a carer as her health slowly deteriorated. Carol was closely following the advice of a mysterious American doctor promising to cure her thyroid condition - as a postmortem reveals that the couple had lethal levels of antihistamine and fentanyl in their systems, Ellena and Luke are arrested on suspicion of murder as detectives search for answers.

programme.title: The Essex Millionaire Murders
programme.desc: The concluding part of a two-part documentary series. Detectives raid Luke D'Wit's home and seize a huge stash of prescription drugs - including fentanyl and antihistamine - that are both found in the Baxters' postmortem as police press Luke to explain his relationship to Carol Baxter's mysterious American physician Dr Andrea Bowden. Luke has been mixing 'medicinal' drinks for Carol on Dr Bowden's instructions, but detectives can find no trace of her existence - meanwhile, Ellena Baxter is completely cleared of her parents' murders and agrees to be interviewed as a witness for the police. As Ellena slowly realises that Luke has been a cuckoo in the family nest, detectives spend months combing through D'Wit's multiple digital devices to piece together the scale of his deception and cruelty.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: June 1944 to August 1944. American and British troops in Normandy are bogged down in the hedgerows, while in the Pacific, the marines fight their costliest battle to date on the island of Saipan. Back home, dreaded telegrams from the War Department begin arriving at a rate inconceivable just one year earlier. But by mid-August, the Germans are in full retreat out of France, and on 25 August, after four years of Nazi occupation, Paris is liberated. A series by Ken Burns. Part 8 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: Autumn 1944. In September of 1944, with their troops in Europe stalled on the German border having outrun their supply lines, Allied commanders gamble on a risky plan to drop thousands of airborne troops behind enemy lines in Holland. When the mission ends in disaster, it becomes painfully clear that the war in Europe will not end before winter. In the Pacific, on the island of Peleliu, the marines fight one of the most brutal campaigns of the war. A series by Ken Burns. Part 9 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: Autumn 1944. In the late autumn of 1944 American soldiers suffer terrible losses when they are ordered into the forbidding and fiercely defended terrain of the Hrtgen Forest and the Vosges Mountains. In the Central Pacific, to the delight of audiences back home, General MacArthur returns to the island of Leyte. But months of bloody fighting lie ahead before the Philippine Islands, and the people imprisoned on them, can be liberated. A series by Ken Burns. Part 10 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: Winter 1944 to 1945. The Allies are unprepared for Hitler's counterattack in the Ardennes Forest of Belgium and Luxembourg. It is the biggest battle of the war on the Western Front, fought during the coldest winter in memory. By the time the Battle of the Bulge is over, Hitler's enormous gamble has ended in disaster and the Russians are approaching Berlin. Meanwhile, in the Santo Tomas Camp in the Philippines, thousands of internees await liberation. A series by Ken Burns. Part 11 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: Winter to Spring 1945. On the island of Iwo Jima, the marines face 21,000 Japanese defenders who, without hope of reinforcement, have been ordered to kill as many Americans as possible before being killed themselves. Once the island is taken, Allied bombers set the cities of Japan ablaze, killing thousands and leaving millions homeless. In Europe, Americans are crossing the Rhine and driving into Germany, while the Russians are within 50 miles of Berlin. A series by Ken Burns. Part 12 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: Spring 1945. In the Pacific, Americans fight on the island of Okinawa while kamikaze pilots wreak havoc on the fleet offshore. In Europe, allied forces rapidly push across Germany from the east and west, and American and British troops discover the true horrors of the Nazis' industrialised barbarism at Buchenwald, Dachau, Mauthausen and other concentration camps. Finally, on 8 May, with their country in ruins and their Fuhrer dead, the Germans surrender. A series by Ken Burns. Part 13 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: May to December 1945. In June, the battle on Okinawa ends yet Japan's rulers, despite the agony their people are enduring, resist unconditional surrender. On 6 August 1945, an American plane drops an atomic bomb on Hiroshima. Two days later, Russia declares war against Japan. A second atomic bomb is dropped on Nagasaki and, finally, Japan surrenders. In the following months, hundreds of thousands of American servicemen and women return home. A series by Ken Burns. Part 14 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: December 1941 to March 1942. The Japanese attack on Pearl Harbor in December 1941 thrusts the United States into the global cataclysm that will eventually touch every family on every street in every town in America. Within a few months, millions of young men have entered the armed forces and are beginning to train for war. A series by Ken Burns. Part 1 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: March 1942 to December 1942. With U-boats menacing the East Coast, and little good news from overseas, many worry that the United States is utterly unprepared to fight in a 'total war'. But after six months of gruelling combat on Guadalcanal, the Americans finally stop Japan's expansion in the Pacific. A series by Ken Burns. Part 2 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: January 1943 to June 1943. American troops land in North Africa and test themselves for the first time against the German and Italian armies, learning to set aside the notion that killing is a sin, and adopting the outlook that 'killing is a craft'. Back home, cities become booming 'war towns' overnight as nearly all manufacturing is converted to the war effort, and thousands of women become industrial workers. A series by Ken Burns. Part 3 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: July 1943 to December 1943. On daylight bombing missions, American airmen gamble with their lives against overwhelming odds to bring the war to the heart of Hitler's vast empire. Allied forces invade Sicily and then Italy but, as they grind their way towards Rome, the weather turns bad and the terrain grows more and more forbidding. Twisting mountain roads and blown bridges have to be negotiated while under constant German fire. A series by Ken Burns. Part 4 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: November 1943 to February 1944. In November, the US marines take the tiny Pacific atoll of Tarawa, but at a terrible cost. Back home, Japanese-Americans are permitted to form a special segregated infantry unit and begin to train for combat. As the war economy booms, ugly racial violence erupts in cities across the country. Overseas, in the mountains south of Rome, the allies try to fight their way around the edges of Monte Cassino, but are stopped cold. A series by Ken Burns. Part 5 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: January 1944 to June 1944. American and British troops are pinned down at Anzio for months, while at Monte Cassino, the killing goes on and on. African-Americans, incensed at the segregation of the armed forces, put pressure on the military to make some changes. In May, allied soldiers at Cassino and Anzio resume their drive northward in Italy, liberating Rome on 4 June, but they let the retreating German army get away. A series by Ken Burns. Part 6 of 14.

programme.title: The War
programme.desc: 6 June 1944: D-Day. In the early hours of 6 June 1944, the invasion of France begins. A million-and-a-half men take part. It is the bloodiest day in American history since the Civil War, though the Allies succeed in tearing a 45-mile gap in Hitler's vaunted Atlantic Wall. By day's end more than 150,000 men have landed on French soil, and more men, equipment and supplies are coming ashore every hour. A series by Ken Burns. Part 7 of 14.

programme.title: Terror on the Prairie
programme.desc: True Grit meets The Handmaid’s Tale in this highly-unsettling and ruthlessly vicious female-led western thriller. On the Montana plains, a frontier woman must protect herself against a ruthless gang of outlaws hell-bent on revenge. Starring Gina Carano (The Mandalorian), Samaire Armstrong (The O.C), Nick Searcy (The Shape of Water), and Gabriel-Kane Day Lewis (Daniel Day Lewis’ son).

programme.title: Feedback
programme.desc: Starring Eddie Marsan (This is England), Paul Anderson (Peaky Blinders) and Ivana Baquero (Pans Labyrinth) and from the creators of Rec. Black Mirror meets Die Hard. Jarvis is a star journalist of a successful London late night radio show. One evening, two armed men burst in and take control. Their mission: to shed light on a scandal that could spell the end of Jarvis' established career.

programme.title: Evidence
programme.desc: A terrifying take on found-footage-horror, this chilling film revolves around a team of detectives (Stephen Moyer: True Blood and Radha Mitchell: London has Fallen), who attempt to piece together what happened at the scene of a brutal massacre, using a number of recording devices found at the crime scene. Prepare yourself for a petrifying and spine-tingling nightmare with a chilling turn.

programme.title: Three Musketeers
programme.desc: France is in turmoil and a new, naive King finds himself manipulated by the evil Cardinal Richelieu (James Cosmo). With a corrupt commander of the royal guard by his side the Cardinal employs the expertise of the wicked Milady de Winter in a plot to bring down the monarchy. As France burns the Cardinal will take control. All that stands between them and victory are the remnants of an elite group.

programme.title: Salt Beef and Rye
programme.desc: This vibrant documentary is inspired by the colourful characters who frequent the world famous Brick Lane. London's reputation as the cultural hub of the world can be attributed in part to its deep-rooted history and diverse communities. Salt Beef & Rye takes audiences on a tour through one of the city's most influential streets.

programme.title: Shelter
programme.desc: A high-octane, edge-of-your-seat thriller, starring Neta Riskin and Golshifteh Farahani. Israeli Mossad agent, Naomi is sent to protect Mona, a beautiful Lebanese informant who is recovering from plastic surgery to conceal her identity. In a safe house in Hamburg, the women form an unexpected bond, and experience a complex labyrinth of mistrust, loyalty, deception and betrayal.

programme.title: Mythica: The Dark Spore
programme.desc: Certain to enthral fans of Game of Thrones -the second in this fantastical franchise is darker than ever. When a powerful relic is stolen, Marek faces a new sinister enemy, set on reclaiming the Darkspore for his master Szorlok. Now Marek and her friends must race through creature-infested lands, to an abandoned underground city, to save themselves from an imminent deadly evil.

programme.title: JT Leroy
programme.desc: A captivating retelling of one of the literary worlds most infamous hoaxes. Laura Albert (Laura Dern) writes as her avatar, a disenfranchised young queer man named JT LeRoy. When her novel becomes a best-seller, she wants to remain anonymous. Enter her boyfriends androgynous sister Savannah (Kristen Stewart), who agrees to be JT in the public eye.

programme.title: Edge of the World
programme.desc: The Revenant meets Last of the Mohicans, this is the epic, swashbuckling adventure story that inspired The Man Who Would Be King. Starring Jonathan Rhys Meyers (The Tudors) as Sir James Brook, the English adventurer who fought pirates and slavery to rule a kingdom in the jungles of Borneo in 1840. As he embarks on a lifelong crusade to end head-hunting, he is framed for murder and piracy charges.

programme.title: Dark Tide
programme.desc: Halle Berry plays a traumatised shark expert who returns to deep waters one year after an almost fatal encounter with a great white shark. She battles her own fears to lead a thrill-seeking businessman on a dive into a dangerous section of water known as "Shark Alley."

programme.title: The Ledge
programme.desc: An edge-of-your-seat survival thriller starring Brittany Ashworth (Hostile) and Ben Lamb (Divergent). When Kelly captures the murder of her best friend on camera while on a rock climbing trip, she becomes the next target of a group of friends who will stop at nothing to destroy the evidence. Kelly finds herself in a free-climbing chase up a freezing mountain, pursued by the group of murderous men.

programme.title: Mickey and the Bear
programme.desc: A powerful and heartfelt coming-of-age story, starring Camila Morrone (Death Wish) and James Badge Dale (13 Hours). Mickey is torn between the freedom she craves and the love she has for her father. As a toxic relationship with her addict father forms and in a desperate search for independence and her own identity, she risks family, heartbreak, and her standing in the only place she can call home.

programme.title: Shut In
programme.desc: Alone. Afraid. Shut In. Get ready for an intense thrill ride of survival at any cost! A young mother finds herself barricaded inside a pantry by her violent ex. With her kids on the other side of the door and the impending threat of violence, she must do whatever it takes to escape and get her kids out of the house.

programme.title: The Owners
programme.desc: One night in 1990s rural England, a retired couple finds their isolated house besieged by a gang of young criminals. The thieves think it will be easy to make them give up the secret of their safe. But they have no idea what nightmare they've gotten themselves into as they fight to escape the house alive.

programme.title: Blood Harvest
programme.desc: Hysteria, secrets, blame and judgement, it's time for a blood harvest. In an idyllic 1873 American Protestant village times are harsh and the grass is always greener on the other side. As the village suffers, one woman prospers and there are grumblings that she may be in league with the devil. Blood and secrets are shed and the cost of survival is revealed in this descent into the supernatural.

programme.title: Blood Harvest

programme.title: A Good Woman is Hard to Find
programme.desc: A dynamic killer thriller, firmly on the pulses of stark social commentary, Abner Pastoll (director of Road Games) crafts a dazzling, dark and daring journey through Northern Irelands criminal underbelly. Widowed Sarah (tour de force Sarah Bolger: Emelie) is desperate to know who murdered her husband. Coerced into helping a drug-dealer, she takes drastic action to protect her kids.

programme.title: The Void
programme.desc: Enter this blood-soaked nightmare at your own risk. When police officer Carter happens upon a blood-soaked figure limping down a deserted road, he rushes the man to a hospital, only to discover a horrifying reality all linked to the mysterious hooded cult figures who are surrounding the hospital. Now Carter must lead the survivors on a hellish voyage in a bid to survive! Totally mind-bending!

programme.title: Killer Sofa
programme.desc: Best to not hide behind your sofa for this one! Killer Sofa does for chairs what Jaws did for sharks. When a killer Lazy Boy chair falls in love with a girl, its up to a disgraced Jewish Rabbi, a Voodoo sorceress and a couple of broken-hearted detectives to ?gure out how to stop the bloody carnage that will follow. This completely bonkers comedy horror is sofa-king-good!

programme.title: Jellyfish
programme.desc: Hailed as this yearÕs breakout British drama, Jellyfish boasts an incredible performance from BAFTA nominee Liv Hill. SarahÕs life as a young carer has turned her into a teenage terror. When her teacher helps her channel her ferocious wit into stand-up comedy, her lifeÕs delicate balance is set on a collision course. A sincere look at a young woman who, against all odds finds her voice.

programme.title: Office Uprising
programme.desc: Get ready for the worst work day ever in this absurdly funny zombie infestation! An underachiever (Brenton Thwaites: Pirates of the Caribbean: Salazars Revenge) working at a weapons manufacturing firm must rescue his one true love from psychotic zombie co-workers who have been weaponized by Zolt, a new energy drink. Co-starring Jane Levy (Dont Breathe) and Karan Soni (Deadpool).

programme.title: The True Don Quixote
programme.desc: Down on his luck, Danny (Tim Blake Nelson – HBO’s Watchmen) escapes the world by diving deep into the fantasy novels that bring him comfort. Diving a little too deep, he soon begins to believe that he himself is a great knight. Grabbing his cardboard armour, a sword and roping in his trusty squire Sancho (Jacob Batalon), they embark on an insane adventure, where great lessons are learned.

programme.title: The Bombing
programme.desc: Inspired by the heroic, untold true story of Chongqing. Starring legends Bruce Willis (Die Hard) and Adrien Brody (The Pianist), this pulse-pounding war epic centres around the courage of Chinas citizens during WWII. As U.S. Air Force commander Jack Johnson trains the Chinese aviators to battle Japanese fighters, a hot-headed pilot begs to fly a powerful bomber that could stop the attacks.

programme.title: A Rainy Day in New York
programme.desc: Woody Allen returns to the romantic fields of previous hits Vicky Cristina Barcelona and Midnight in Paris, assembling an all-star cast including Timothée Chalamet, Elle Fanning, Selena Gomez, Jude Law, Diego Luna and Liev Schreiber, for a charming, comedic tale set amidst the dizzying streets of The Big Apple, as romantic weekend plans are soon dashed as quickly as the sunlight turns to showers.

programme.title: A Kid Like Jake
programme.desc: A heart-breaking family drama starring Claire Danes, Jim Parsons and Octavia Spencer. Parents, Alex and Greg are approaching an important crossroads - finding the "right" primary school for their son, Jake, a precocious four-year-old who happens to prefer Disney princesses to G.I. Joe. However, as Jake's behaviour becomes increasingly erratic and perplexing, a rift begins to emerge between them.

programme.title: The Bet
programme.desc: A woman makes a bet with her husband that she can get the next man she sees to propose. Enter Albert, a lonely, eccentric man who believes he will never be loved, in this delightful, hilarious film about marriage, love and second chances.

programme.title: The Birthday Cake
programme.desc: This hard-hitting mob-drama stars Ewan McGregor (Trainspotting), Val Kilmer (Top Gun) and William Fichtner (Prison Break). Gio, the son of a murdered mobster and the nephew of Brooklyn mob boss, carries on the family tradition of bringing a celebration cake to his uncle’s house. But Gio’s life changes forever as he begins to piece together what really happened to his father.

programme.title: Betrayed
programme.desc: Based on shocking true events. In November 1942 hundreds of Jewish citizens in Norway were taken from their homes. Men, women and children forced on to a ship headed for Oslo, with the destination set to be where the industrialisation of human suffering became a horrifying reality - Auschwitz. Follow one family's struggle as the life they knew and loved is ripped from them by the tides of war.

programme.title: Let Her Out
programme.desc: Spine-tingling, this breakout body horror pays homage to director David Cronenberg. Waking up in hospital, bike courier Helen has suffered a traumatic head injury. But when she begins experiencing dark visions, blackouts and a strange presence around her, she knows she is in danger. Dark, disturbing and perfectly eerie, this horror will make you jump out of your skin.

programme.sub-title: The John Altinger Affair (Scenario For A Murder)
programme.desc: Water is at the centre of the human experience. The source of life on earth, it is also a place of mystery and danger. For criminals, water is the perfect accomplice for the perfect crime: it erases, absorbs, and carries the bodies, conceals weapons and washes away evidence. For detectives, water is a crafty adversary. It never confesses, forcing the investigators to employ extraordinary measures to discover the truth. Dark Waters of Crime does not simply oppose the criminals and the investigators. It brings into play a third party, powerful, mysterious, and tenacious.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: A retired fireman on a morning bike ride notices a burning bundle in a farmer’s field…and recognizes the smell of burning human flesh. Investigators at the scene find an unrecognizable body, a distinctive lighter, 2 pairs of latex gloves and the box they came in, paper towels and torn scraps of an office memo. State of the art forensics, dogged police work, and some extraordinary turns of events lead police to the murder scene - the medical room of a ball bearings factory, and the arrest of a former Armenian mafia thug turned English family man for the brutal murder of his cruel ex-boss.

programme.title: Criminally Insane
programme.desc: Criminally Insane takes viewers on an unprecedented journey through the Clifton T. Perkins hospital in Jessup, Maryland, a maximum-security institution for the criminally insane. All the patients at Perkins have been found not guilty by reason of insanity, and virtually all have committed extremely violent crimes. Elsoudani El-Wahhabi stabbed a woman to death, then cut out his own tongue. Brian Bechtold murdered both his parents with a shotgun when he was just 17 years old. Todd E. beat his mother with a baseball bat, then finished her off with a kitchen knife. In one hour, CRIMINALLY INSANE portrays the most intimate details of life among the dangerously mentally ill. We learn what’s being done for them and, more importantly, who decides whether these terrifying individuals are ready to be released.

There he teams up with Slater, living his wildest fantasies in a celluloid world where anything is possible.

programme.title: The Patriot (2000)
programme.desc: In 1776 South Carolina, widower Benjamin Martin (Gibson) finds himself thrust into the midst of the American Revolutionary War as he helplessly watches his family being torn apart by the savage forces of the British Redcoats. When his oldest son's wife is ruthlessly killed, and his young son is shot through the back before his eyes, Martin is unable to suppress the soldier within that he tried to bury with his own military past. Unable to remain silent, he recruits a band of unlikely volunteers to take up arms against the British. Fighting to protect his famliy's freedom and his country's independence, Martin discovers the pain of betrayal, the redemption of revenge, and the passion of love.

programme.title: Love at First Lie
programme.desc: When Sarah Goldman, a lovely young school teacher in Chicago, wants to please her parents, she invents a boyfriend whom she believes will be the man of her mother's dreams. When her parents insist on meeting the man, Sarah hires Bob, an actor, to pretend to be her "beau". The masquerade works flawlessly for a time and brings comic situations, but in the end, their lives are irrevocably changed.

programme.title: Not Cinderella’s Type
programme.desc: Indy lives with her aunt and uncle and believes her life is fine until an accident brings a new guy into her life. Bryant Bailey is not Indy's type - she's never been into guys like him. But then again, she's never really known anyone so stubborn and caring that can also help her discover who she is and what she's worth. A modern telling of Cinderella, based on the novel by Jenni James.

programme.title: Ruling of the Heart
programme.desc: Judge Morgan has become known for his no-nonsense toughness in court. He rules fast and he rules hard, barely noticing the person on the other end of his decisions. When he gets stuck in a cafe during a snowstorm, he is surprised to discover two of the other customers stranded with him happen to be people recently in his court, with verdicts handed down that have made him very unpopular. As the night unfolds in the small cafe, unexpected truth emerges from both sides that changes everything.

programme.title: Romance In The Air
programme.desc: After learning her marketing job is on the line, Eden returns to Lake Tahoe where she used to spend her summers growing up. Intending to relax and recharge so she can tackle her job again, she is surprised to find her childhood friend and sweetheart Riley is still living next door. She finds purpose in helping Riley propel his struggling hot air balloon tour company, and also finds herself drawn to him and their dear past. However, Eden sees Riley and Tahoe as temporary, while her life—and boyfriend—back home await her. She can’t admit that she and Riley could have a future, even if that’s exactly what she wants. When she’s willing to take a risk for what her heart wants, her life will take off with her true love.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League in Holland at the Dru Factory in ULFT. A great location for a spectacular battle with 14 Athletes over 3 events! The first 3 events in this episode are Truckpull/ Superyoke and Farmerswalk, with 2 massive logs of 150 kg in their hands. So, join us for the show of strength, the place of power, it’s the circus of the extreme.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Ladies and gentleman, boys and girls, strongman fans across the world, we are back for SCL Holland part two. Get ready because it’s about to get heavy. The Strongman Champions League in Holland, continues with the last 3 events, here at the Dru Factory in ULFT. The events in this episode are the Viking Press, Wheel Flip and the Atlas Stones, with 180 kg in the end.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the first time ever, the World’s Strongest Latino competition has begun. This two-day event in Porto, Portugal, features 20 athletes from around the world competing in 8 events. After 4 grueling events, the top 12 will advance to the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League World Record Breakers 2023 starts with a 25-ton snow plow! Crazy machines are pulled and pushed, with many kilograms moved. A few new world records are set in this competition.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We have returned to the powerhouse of Portugal for an edge-of-your-seat galactic battle. If all the planets collided at once, it wouldn’t compare to the bang of this show. Get ready for the battle of the beasts; it’s the heaviest show in the universe, the Strongman Champions League.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL UK has landed in Gloucester it is workout war fitness for the ferocious, it’s going to be a a battle of the brutal, a rampage of the roofless. This is going to be a massacre of the muscles. You know it by now, but just in case you don’t, this is strongman champions league.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: On the menu this week it’s medieval madness, we’ve come back to the middle ages to test our noble men through a muscle gaining of events. They are hoping and we are hoping that one will survive to take the title of the world’s strongest Viking. The official World's Strongest Viking is this time in Finland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This week is a good one, can you feel the energy? Sit still, just look at me and try and feel the energy, because I can tell you, the atmosphere here is electric, it’s explosive, there is a pure elemental force going through these athletes' veins. I’m shaking because it’s Poland, it’s powerful, it’s strongman champions league, and you know what I'm going to say, get ready because it’s about to get heavy.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: SCL Poland part 2 - Who will win the title in Poland and take 25 points for the world ranking. It is very exciting on the top, in part 1 between Poland and Latvia. Another great episode with super strongman events such as: Bag Toss Medley, Log Lift Reps and the Powerstairs. Also an interview with Mateusz Kieloszkowski, the all time favorite champion from Poland.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: It’s time to show our strength and gain respect from the gods of Olympus. Our gladiators have many events set out by no other than Hercules himself. The coliseum is ready here on this mythological island of Cyprus, so we have landed in Limassol were again 12 Top Strongmen are battling for the title and ranking points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The only and official world championship Truckpulling for its 10th year, again at the Strongman Champions league. With the 3 times Worldchampion Kelvin de Ruiter – defending his title. This championship has trucks in all shapes and sizes which is a lot like our athletes, there all different pay loads, but does the biggest win or is it the strongest.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Years and years of determination has brought us here today, when all the walls felt like they were caving in perseverance. When their bodies were screaming, hurting, shouting stop, beneath. These are the things which make up a man, these are the things that bring you world finalists. programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: When John crashes Cab 804, the cabbies are shocked into a period of mourning, as they reminisce about the wild and memorable events that occurred when they were driving the legendary cab.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: It’s a dream come true for Tony when he’s challenged by an aging ex-champ, but he has more than just a fight on his hand when the opposition unveils its secret weapon.

programme.desc: The cabbies are in for a comedy surprise when the small town kid Bobby befriends, Steve, lands a big role as Romeo the first day he arrives in the Big Apple.

programme.title: Taxi

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: Bobby and Tony’s friendship is on the line when they become embroiled in a hilarious love triangle and attempt to outdo each other in vying for the affection of a beautiful young lady.

programme.title: Taxi

programme.desc: A courageous man who's living proof you can reinvent yourself more times than a Love Island contestant. He went from pulling pints in the Queen Vic to pulling BAFTAs for documentaries…

programme.title: Yellow Couch with Jeremy Lynch - Lucy Bronze
programme.sub-title: The Yellow Couch with Jeremy Lynch - Lucy Bronze
programme.desc: Tonight’s guest has lived that journey. From a football-loving kid to one of the world’s finest players, she’s lifted major trophies, captained teams, and become a role model for millions. Lucy Bronze welcome on the Yellow Couch.

programme.title: The Yellow Couch with Jeremy Lynch - Charlotte Crosby
programme.sub-title: The Yellow Couch with Jeremy Lynch - Charlotte Crosby
programme.desc: She first burst onto our screens on Geordie Shore—back when her biggest commitment was to Jägerbombs and fake tan. Since then she’s gone from wild nights in Newcastle towinning Celebrity Big Brother.

programme.desc: Today, we’ve got a guest who has lived several lives in one. On the pitch, he was a fierce left-back who collected trophies like kids collect Pokémon cards. Off the pitch, he’s become the man of Monday mornings.

programme.desc: A guest who has a huge drive and work ethics and has overcome some hurdles that have possibly made him stronger. His entrances make Harry Styles look underdressed at Coachella.
